An Unsuccessful Hunt

The bandit chief says the New Village's people have surrounded his camp so closely that hunting is almost impossible. Meanwhile, the villagers hunt even on traditional bandit grounds. He asks you to drive them away.

Objectives

Reach the western Foothills

Find the hunters' camp

Drive away the hunters

Collect the loot
